'''Haresh''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Haresh was loyal to the [[Dark Council]]lor [[Darth Vowrawn]] at the time of [[Darth Baras]]'s plot to assume the position of the [[Emperor's Voice (Sith Empire)|Voice of the Emperor]] and was in charge of the security of Vowrawn's secret [[Corellia/Legends|Corellian]] stronghold. During the [[Battle of Corellia]] the Sith boldly made their base of operations inside a Republic-aligned corporate building, by having their soldiers put on Republic uniforms and make a show in front of the holocameras, so that Republic enemies had no reason to suspect something had gone awry. When the [[Empire's Wrath|Emperor's Wrath]], a former apprentice of Darth Baras, [[Mission to Corellia (Emperor's Wrath)|arrived]] to protect Darth Vowrawn from Baras' assassins on the orders of [[Servant Eleven]], Haresh didn't believe him and engaged the Wrath in combat, forcing the latter to kill Haresh.<ref name="Protect Vowrawn" />
